injuries.description: acute traumatic closed fracture of the right tibia
source: found to be suffering from acute traumatic closed fracture of the right tibia and compartment syndrome.
injuries.icd_description: Fracture of lower leg, including ankle, unspecified

source: found to be suffering from acute traumatic closed fracture of the right tibia and compartment syndrome.
injuries.icd_description: Injury of multiple muscles, fasciae or tendons at lower leg level

injuries.description: open wound at the site of the fracture
source: debridement and skin grafting of an open wound at the site of the fracture

manifestations.description: lack of mobility in the knee and ankle of the right leg
pain from time to time and particularly after extended periods of walking
residual stiffness of the fractured limb
reduction in the range of movements in the right leg relative to the left
impaired agility with difficulty returning to work as a container barge worker
used crutches to get around for close to a year after the accident

treatments_received: fasciotomy (emergency) and application of an external fixation device to stabilize the fractured tibia
removal of the external fixator, debridement and skin grafting of an open wound at the site of the fracture and close reduction and internal fixation of the fractured tibia

losses.description: lack of mobility in the knee and ankle of the right leg
impaired agility; would have difficulty returning to work as a container barge worker

losses.category: Loss of ability to engage in sports and hobbies
losses.description: residual disabilities affecting ability to play sport
